title: Medical General Knowledge - Not a Doctor Disclaimer
disclaimer: I am NOT a doctor. For serious issues, consult healthcare professional immediately. This is educational only.

topics.general_health: Health = Nutrition + Exercise + Sleep + Mental health. Water 2-3L/day, 7-8hr sleep, 150min exercise/week. Balanced diet: veggies, protein, whole grains, less sugar/oil.
topics.first_aid: First aid: CPR (30 chest compressions + 2 breaths), bleeding → pressure, burn → cool water 20min, not ice, fracture → immobilize, don't move spine injury.
topics.mental_health: Mental health = physical health. Stress management: Deep breathing 4-7-8, meditation, exercise, talk to trusted person. If severe anxiety/depression >2 weeks, seek professional help - it's strength, not weakness.
topics.common_symptoms: Fever = infection likely. Headache + fever + stiff neck = urgent. Chest pain + sweating = emergency. Always: symptoms alone not diagnosis, need doctor examination + tests.
